question: Why did Macy's let its parade balloons fly away?
notes: First four scenes of Short 18, ending at 23.5 s. Source voice and word timestamps are copied unchanged.

scenes.line: A student pilot once flew her plane straight into a giant balloon cat. Why was a parade balloon up there at all?

art.desc: A 1930s biplane flying into a huge striped tabby cat balloon; the young pilot, goggles up, surprised

scenes.line: Because after its Thanksgiving parade, Macy's let the balloons go on purpose, as a prize hunt.

art.desc: Parade handlers letting go of their ropes as a dragon balloon lifts off over rooftops

scenes.line: In 1928, bringing one back won you a hundred dollars.

art.desc: A grinning man hauling a saggy balloon with a prize tag

scenes.chapter: A reward for bringing them back

scenes.line: So people fought over them. On a rooftop in Queens, a tug-of-war tore a tiger balloon to pieces.

art.desc: Two men on a roof in a tug-of-war over a tiger balloon, tearing it
